submissions.findingTextShort: A 2025 overview of systematic reviews maps human clinical evidence for oral EGb 761 across conditions but does not make arbitrary ginkgo products equivalent.
submissions.findingTextNormalized: A 2025 overview of systematic reviews evaluates the proprietary standardized Ginkgo biloba extract EGb 761 across clinical conditions. It confirms a substantial human evidence base while also making formulation identity central: outcomes obtained with EGb 761 cannot be inherited automatically by generic leaf powder, tea, tincture, or differently standardized extracts. The current generic profile's EGb 761 dosage language therefore needs source-linked formulation provenance before promotion.
submissions.usageContext: Review-of-reviews evidence for oral proprietary standardized extract EGb 761 across heterogeneous clinical conditions.
submissions.uncertaintyNote: Broad evidence mapping does not create one cross-condition efficacy claim or validate arbitrary ginkgo products.

submissions.findingTextShort: A systematic review of EGb 761 in mild neurocognitive impairment covered nine reports and 946 patients; formulation and disease-stage boundaries are essential.
submissions.findingTextNormalized: A systematic review of EGb 761 in mild neurocognitive impairment included nine reports representing 946 patients. Any reported cognition or function signal belongs to the studied standardized extract and mild-neurocognitive-impairment population; it cannot be generalized to healthy-user memory enhancement, dementia prevention, or generic ginkgo leaf products.
submissions.populationContext: Patients with mild neurocognitive impairment represented in nine reports / 946 patients.
submissions.usageContext: Proprietary standardized Ginkgo biloba extract EGb 761.
submissions.uncertaintyNote: Disease stage and standardized-extract identity constrain inference.

submissions.findingTextShort: A 2026 pooled analysis of four randomized trials in post-infarct dementia reported cognition/ADL/global signals, with manufacturer funding and employee authorship requiring explicit provenance.
submissions.findingTextNormalized: A 2026 pooled meta-analysis of four randomized trials totaling 488 patients with dementia after cerebral infarction reported favorable cognition, activities-of-daily-living and global-assessment signals for EGb 761. The source received funding from the EGb 761 manufacturer and included an employee author, so sponsor/product provenance must travel with the finding. The clinical population and proprietary extract cannot be generalized to prevention or healthy cognition.
submissions.populationContext: Four randomized trials / 488 patients with dementia after cerebral infarction.
submissions.usageContext: Proprietary EGb 761 in a post-cerebral-infarction dementia population.
submissions.uncertaintyNote: Manufacturer funding, employee authorship, pooled-study design and narrow population constrain certainty and generalization.
